services.name: Open Gym
services.desc: Whether you want to work on a skill, hit an extra lifting session, make up a missed class, or just move at your own pace, Open Gym is your time. The space is yours: barbells, rigs, rowers, bikes, kettlebells, dumbbells, everything in the gym is available to you. Spots are limited each hour to keep the floor open and the equipment accessible, so registration is required. Book your slot in advance and show up ready to work. Open Gym runs alongside scheduled classes Monday through Friday 6 AM to 7:30 PM, and Saturday 9 to 11 AM. Open Gym is for athletes who need flexibility without sacrificing access to a great facility. If you sign up for any monthly membership within 30 days of your drop-in, the $25 fee is credited back to youon your first month. Try a class, and if it clicks, your trial doesn't cost extra. A drop-in is a single class at FitHub CrossFit REP, no membership required. It's the easiest way to experience how we coach, what our programming feels like, and whether the community is the right fit, without any commitment.
